t: The Coachman's Reins: Guiding Agentic AI with Prompt Contracts
s: This article explores managing unpredictable agentic AIs by shifting from conversational interfaces to structured 'prompt contracts'. It leverages atomic Git operations for transactional integrity, ensuring either full success or complete rollback, while preserving lessons learned from failures. The focus is on resolving context window bottlenecks by modularizing AI tools.
sub: Atomic Git operations for transactional AI integrity
Context window management via tool modularization
Transition from conversational AI to CLI/TUI agents
Debugging non-standard databases in AI systems
